# Dflamez Shotz

> Dflamez Shotz is a photography and visual storytelling studio in Akure, Nigeria.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://dflamezshotz.com/): Soul portraits and visual stories.
- [About](https://dflamezshotz.com/about): Meet Dflamez Shotz and learn about the creative approach.
- [Services](https://dflamezshotz.com/services): Photography and videography services.
- [Gallery](https://dflamezshotz.com/gallery): Selected portraits, photography, and cinematic work.
- [Hire](https://dflamezshotz.com/hire): Start a project or request a quote.
- [Contact](https://dflamezshotz.com/contact): Contact details and enquiry form.
- [Gold's Pen](https://dflamezshotz.com/blog): Articles about photography, creativity, and visual storytelling.
